pyDymak The build, prompt by prompt · seventeen steps ← Dymak HQ dashboard
Tutorial
Copy each prompt, see what it delivered, use the dashboard it produced
The idea

This is a tutorial in building a real design tool by talking to an AI — no coding knowledge needed. The subject is a roof: one big circle with a smaller hole through it, pushed off centre, the two edges sloping against each other.

The photographs show the kind of building we are chasing — a round hall whose roof dips down into an off-centre garden. Over seventeen prompts, plain written requests grow into a live dashboard for shaping that roof, and then into a companion tool that places the real columns and beams inside Revit. Every prompt on the following tabs can be copied and tried for yourself.

The reference

The recommended numbers to match the pictures sit beside each slider in the dashboard below — dial them in, then drag the 3D view to orbit and compare.

Seventeen prompts, read left to right. Each bar marks when a strand of the work was active — building, fixing. Click a prompt number to jump straight to it.
